title: BCIJelly: An integrated ecosystem for brain-computer interface research
abstract: arXiv:2608.13576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) research relies on multistage computational pipelines, yet progress remains constrained by fragmented data formats, heterogeneous decoder implementations and hardware-specific deployment toolchains, and researchers lack an integrated workflow. Here, we fill this gap with BCIJelly, a unified computational ecosystem that integrates 18 curated BCI datasets, 15 benchmark decoders and an algorithmic library of 80 reusable modules, an automated architecture search (AAS) procedure, and hardware-aware deployment through the toChip pipeline within a single Python framework. AAS constructs task-specific decoders without manual architecture design. It is further extended into a closed-loop mode guided by a large language model (LLM), which uses task specifications, module descriptions and search history to support multitask and cross-species decoding. The toChip pipeline compiles trained decoders for execution on ne

translated_title: BCIJelly：一个用于脑机接口研究的集成生态系统
translated_abstract: 脑机接口（BCI）研究依赖于多阶段计算流程，但进展仍受限于碎片化的数据格式、异构的解码器实现和特定于硬件的部署工具链，研究人员缺乏集成的工作流程。在此，我们通过BCIJelly填补了这一空白，这是一个统一的计算生态系统，在单一Python框架内集成了18个精选的BCI数据集、15个基准解码器、包含80个可复用模块的算法库、自动化架构搜索（AAS）程序，以及通过toChip流程实现的硬件感知部署。AAS无需手动架构设计即可构建任务特定的解码器，并进一步扩展为由大型语言模型（LLM）引导的闭环模式，该模式利用任务规范、模块描述和搜索历史来支持多任务和跨物种解码。toChip流程将训练好的解码器编译，以便在神经形态硬件上执行。
tldr: BCIJelly是一个集成18个数据集、15个解码器和80个模块的Python生态系统，通过自动化架构搜索和LLM引导的闭环模式，以及toChip硬件部署流程，解决了BCI研究中数据、算法和部署碎片化的问题。
en_tdlr: BCIJelly is an integrated Python ecosystem that unifies 18 datasets, 15 decoders, and 80 modules, with automated architecture search and LLM-guided closed-loop mode, plus toChip hardware deployment, addressing fragmentation in BCI research.
